evidence.source: Standalone runtime/tests, frontend and native tests
evidence.summary: Frontend 86 passed after reducing provider form to BASE URL, API KEY, MODEL NAME. Covers automatic Responses suffix, complete-endpoint compatibility, exact unchanged credential endpoint, blank-key preservation, hidden environment configuration and key clearing. Python 1256 passed and Rust 8 passed, 1 ignored in extraction verification; these layers unchanged by the form simplification. No models used.

evidence.source: Gateway frontend/native regression and installed bundle
evidence.summary: Frontend 418 passed; Rust 870 passed, 2 ignored. Signed 1.0.71 installed; installed binary owns loopback 4317. Retired native commands and active modules absent; only one-release import forwarders remain.

Final signed SessionGraph 0.1.0 installed. Shared launcher uses immutable standalone runtime 709151b7ac082ae19e16. Actual stdio MCP lists 7 tools, recalls and expands fruit-fly evidence. Native graph/status/settings reads succeed, MiniMax-M3 unchanged, 5 Hook events and MCP registration present. model_calls=0. Final reinstall is idempotent.

evidence.source: output/playwright/desktop.png and mobile.png; sg-extract browser session
evidence.summary: Real fruit-fly read-only UI displays nonblank SVG graph; node selection shows matching detail and quoted evidence. Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 checked; mobile document width 390, 24 rendered nodes. Native app rendering/settings read checked separately; manual native fruit-fly selection was not verified.

acceptance_gates.name: Installed resource absence and standalone continuity

evidence.source: Gateway npm test -- --maxWorkers=2; installer tests; standalone runtime/tests
evidence.summary: Gateway 418 frontend tests, 4 retirement guards and 26 version/installer tests passed. Standalone full Python suite: 1254 passed, one external deprecation warning; two obsolete forwarding tests removed. Credential test fixture now isolates runtime home from saved local keys. One HostBridge UI timeout in the initial concurrent run passed in the consolidated two-worker rerun without changing test logic or timeout. Production Rust build succeeded; no fresh full Rust suite claimed. No paid inference.

evidence.source: Gateway app:build, app:install and installed bundle/process inspection
evidence.summary: Signed Gateway 1.0.73 built and installed at /Applications/Gateway.app; PID 77743 listens on loopback 4317. Built and installed bundles have no SessionGraph resources; compiled frontend has no retired module names or calls. Four exact legacy Gateway-path MCP processes terminated after standalone verification; none remain. Concurrent unrelated 1.0.73 changes preserved.

Installed standalone runtime 709151b7ac082ae19e16 exposes 7 MCP tools; actual stdio recall and expand succeed for fruit-fly project a217c2bc1da5c4913760. Native status/settings/graph reads succeed: 1092 nodes, 591 edges, MiniMax-M3, 5 Hook events, MCP registered, model_calls=0. Old Codex MCP clients may require reconnect; transparent client reconnection was not verified.

Forwarding vendor tree, obsolete module documents and 29 MB Work Summary cache moved into private recoverable archive; previous build app preserved there too. This is not disk-space reclamation. Active project graph databases, evidence, credentials, queues, shared launcher/state and exported reports untouched. Production-source search has no retired references. Negative regression checks, protective ignore rules, unrelated historical metadata and Git history intentionally retained.

residual_items.description: Gateway forwarding resources and exact old MCP processes removed. Shared state intentionally retains its historical directory name under local-ai-gateway; it is now owned by standalone SessionGraph and must not be deleted.
residual_items.exit_condition: Installed standalone stdio recall/expand passed after Gateway replacement; old clients can reconnect through stable launcher.

residual_items.description: Standalone initial baseline 1cdcfac is committed and pushed. Cleanup changes remain uncommitted; Gateway includes unrelated concurrent changes. Local signed bundles are not Apple-notarized; public distribution is outside this cleanup.
residual_items.exit_condition: Review and commit scoped cleanup separately; create a notarized release when public distribution is requested.

completion.decision: Cleanup implemented and locally verified, including signed Gateway replacement and standalone MCP continuity. No cleanup commit/push or public release claimed; mixed Gateway worktree preserved.
